description: A photograph depicting dry grassland on the Franconian Alb, Germany, specifically identified as juniper heathland. The image is taken under a clear blue sky. In the foreground, a paved or unpaved verge leads to a sparse area of dry grasses and weeds. A chain-link fence, topped with barbed wire, stretches across the midground, separating the immediate foreground from a larger expanse of dry, light-coloured grassland with some scattered taller vegetation. Two tall, dark-coloured poles, possibly utility or surveillance structures, are visible, one in the mid-left and another more prominently on the right. A faint line of trees or bushes forms the distant background horizon. The photograph credit is M. Probeck.
